{{Top}}
The '''Blue Coral Divers Clan''' was one of the new breed of [[Witches of Dathomir|witch clans]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir.]] The clan fished for [[Blue coral/Legends|blue corals]] and allowed both women and men to rule jointly. The Blue Coral Divers feuded with the [[Scissorfists Clan]], another clan that lived near the sea. After [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of fighting, both clans tried to settle their differences through a diplomatic meeting. However, the peace talks ended badly and both clans resumed their feud.<ref name="backlash">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Backlash]]''</ref>
